records.governing_sense_or_question: How should person, community, inherited form, and universal history relate under disputed Russian development?
records.pivot: historical identity relative to communal and external authority

factors.role: coordinates persons without reducing them to isolated units
factors.variation: ecclesial, philosophical, and political uses diverge

factors.role: locates freedom and value within relation
factors.variation: not interchangeable with individual or legal person

factors.role: frames whether development follows, rejects, or transforms European models
factors.variation: Slavophile and Westernizer are contested families, not two fixed essences

dependencies: community claims depend on theological and historical frames
national mission claims depend on selective comparison
constraints: Russian does not mean Orthodox or Slavic in general

records.governing_sense_or_question: Can freedom and creative personhood participate in unity without being absorbed by necessity or totality?
records.pivot: person relative to unity, necessity, and creative transformation

factors.role: relates differentiated beings within an encompassing unity
factors.variation: Solovyov and later receptions assign different theological and political roles

factors.role: resists reduction of person to natural or rational necessity
factors.variation: Berdyaevian and Shestovian critiques of necessity differ

factors.role: enacts transformation irreducible to repetition of given order
factors.variation: religious vocation and human making remain coupled

dependencies: freedom is interpreted through theology and exile
unity must preserve differentiation to avoid absorption
constraints: religious existentialism is not one school
creative freedom is not feature generation

records.governing_sense_or_question: How can plural voices, conscience, responsibility, and enacted life test moral claims without authorial closure?
records.pivot: moral claim relative to voice and lived enactment

factors.role: keeps multiple consciousnesses unfinalized within one work
factors.variation: Bakhtin's account of Dostoevsky is interpretation, not author self-description

factors.role: tests institutional command against lived moral responsibility
factors.variation: literary, Christian, anarchist, and everyday senses differ

factors.role: binds moral truth to refusal of violent means
factors.variation: stronger than generic pacifism and historically disputed

dependencies: voice is evaluated through consequences and responsibility without final synthesis
nonresistance depends on religious and institutional critique
constraints: novel and essay are different warrant forms
no political or pacifist guidance is inferred
records.interpretive_status: source-supported literary-moral family with genre separation

records.governing_sense_or_question: How are ideal forms objectively real in collective material activity, and how did Soviet institutions constrain that inquiry?
records.pivot: ideality relative to socially embodied activity and political institution

factors.role: names socially objective forms embodied in things and practices
factors.variation: neither private mental image nor nonmaterial substance

factors.role: materially produces, transmits, and transforms ideal forms
factors.variation: labor, culture, education, and thought are related but distinct

factors.role: traces concrete contradiction and transformation rather than fixed classification
factors.variation: official formula and independent philosophical method can diverge

dependencies: ideality exists through historically organized social activity
publication and doctrine were constrained by Soviet institutions
constraints: Soviet is not synonymous with Russian
official Marxism does not exhaust Marxist or Soviet philosophy
records.interpretive_status: source-supported Soviet debate with repression boundary

records.governing_sense_or_question: How can self-knowledge disclose an inner person and a congenial vocation that makes happiness practical?
records.pivot: life activity relative to inner nature and affinity

factors.role: centers the inner person, desire, discernment, and transformation
discovers inner nature and practical orientation
factors.variation: Socratic, Christian, and symbolic registers interact

factors.role: matches activity to a person's divinely given inclination
factors.variation: vocation is moral-theological, not job-fit optimization

dependencies: happiness depends on self-knowledge and enacted affinity
biblical interpretation uses inner/outer symbolic structure
constraints: Skovoroda remains in Ukrainian and transimperial custody
language history does not settle national essence
records.interpretive_status: source-supported Ukrainian record with contested custody retained

records.governing_sense_or_question: How can exact description of objects and modes of being connect—or fail to connect—to responsibility under political untruth?
records.pivot: philosophical responsibility relative to object, method, and historical situation

factors.role: separates what is presented through from what an act presents
factors.variation: psychological, logical, and semantic developments differ

factors.role: classifies how objects and works exist and depend on acts or embodiments
factors.variation: Ingarden's realism dispute exceeds literary theory

factors.source_term: péče o duši / solidarita otřesených / život v pravdě
factors.transliteration: péče o duši / solidarita otřesených / život v pravdě
factors.working_gloss: care of soul / solidarity of the shaken / living in truth
factors.role: connects reflection to responsibility and resistance under ideological power
factors.variation: Patočka's phenomenology and Havel's political essay remain distinct

dependencies: methodological clarity depends on institutional practices of justification
dissident responsibility depends on historical exposure and small-scale enactment
constraints: Polish and Czech records are not one school
Europe and truth language require political and postcolonial caution
excluded_combinations: living in truth = factual accuracy field
records.interpretive_status: bounded cross-tradition contrast record; internal alternatives must remain separable
